styleLock.direction: premium kitchen-tool commerce with a grill-side mood
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, brushed steel grey #7C8580 and appliance steel #454A4D for mechanism screens, honed marble #EAE6E0 and subway tile #F2F4F3 for kitchen scenes, deep ember charcoal #1E120C and smoky charcoal #1B1512 for mood and close screens; one background system per shot, never mixed inside a single panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-warm studio light, large front-left softbox key with a low-density fill card, honest soft contact shadow that grounds the product, narrow skimming highlight to read brushed metal grain, ember bounce only on the dark-charcoal screens, no mixed color temperature inside one frame
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte studio white sweep, honed marble #EAE6E0, white fireclay sink edge, brushed stainless #454A4D, matte grill-side steel #7C8580; surfaces stay clean, unbranded and free of printed matter
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, used only for placeholder callout plates, one line per plate, no dense body text, no source wording reproduced
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight icons inside circular discs, one accent color #D93A2B on steel plates, no letters inside icons, no pictograms of awards or stars
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 read of the product silhouette across the set, probe and handle loop always unclipped, segment display always rendered as blank glass with no digits, hands may hold the product but faces stay out of frame
noDrift: no digits, readings or specification numbers anywhere
no brand wordmarks, packaging copy or third-party marks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, deep ember charcoal #1E120C, brushed steel grey #7C8580 and one tomato accent #D93A2B; neutral-warm studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, low-density fill card and honest soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for placeholder callout plates only; thin-line single-weight icons in circular discs on steel plates; matte studio sweep, honed marble, white fireclay and brushed stainless surface system; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale with the folding probe and handle loop unclipped; every segment display rendered as blank glass with no digits; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：①白底机身斜置主图，旁有一盒两卡（包装盒面与折叠导览卡均印满字样）；②手持机身，右侧五条金属卖点栏＋五个圆框线描图标，栏上为秒数与精度类数字；③上格在烤炉边单手翻折探针示意开合，下格机身平放石面熄屏并配电池说明；④深色底第三方字标环绕机身；⑤上格自来水冲洗、下格吸附于不锈钢箱门并配两条引线标签与厨房收纳一角；⑥烤炉上方双手递送牛皮纸礼盒、礼盒内露出包装盒；⑦四宫格用途陈列（烤炉／烤箱／油炸液体／空气炸锅），每格一枚圆框图标加标签。品类判定依据：机身无电加热元件、无电机，属手持小件厨房测量工具，按图归「家居日用／厨房用品」，未沿用源类目提示与「家用电器」写法；Amazon 类目常错挂，不作判定依据。已剥离内容：品牌字标与火焰标志、机身与包装盒与导览卡上一切文字、屏幕读数（全部改写为空白段码 #B9BDBF 无读数）、第三方媒体与机构字标（改为空白印章框）、星级与社会证明、秒数／精度／量程／防护等级／休眠时长／保修等一切数值与承诺，涉及主张一律以 {callout_n}、{selling_point_n} 或空白占位承载；出镜人物仅保留手部与前臂裁切，无可辨识面容。
